create_temporal_match_kernel: create a TemporalMatchKernel module with configurable periods, beta, and Fourier coefficients
compute_tmk_scores: compute temporal match kernel scores between two batches of time series sequences
shift_fv_features: shift Fourier features of a time series by a given temporal offset
merge_fv_features: merge Fourier features from two time series and compute kernel dot products
project_to_probability_simplex: project a tensor onto the probability simplex using sorting and cumulative sum
